query:
SELECT 
  empresaSlug,
  SUM(CAST(metaMensal AS DECIMAL(12,2))) as meta_total,
  COUNT(*) as qtd_metas
FROM metas 
WHERE mes = 5 AND ano = 2026
GROUP BY empresaSlug
ORDER BY meta_total DESC;
